name: aqg-multi-review
description: Use PROACTIVELY for a non-trivial change — a multi-file feature or larger — that needs balanced coverage across all five review dimensions, not a security pass alone; also use it to validate a filled dimension ledger. 5-dimension code review router (logic / edge_cases / security / performance / concurrency) — a cross-LLM panel where each dimension is judged by independent LLMs, not a single vendor's PR review. Two modes — `new` returns dimension-specific focus prompts plus a closeout-importable YAML skeleton; `validate` parses a filled ledger and emits `needs_llm_judgement` for cross-dimension conflicts, unfilled declared dimensions, or 3+ dimensions with findings plus an accept decision when at least one finding is non-LOW or an audit_id is missing. For test quality specifically, see aqg-test-quality-review. The skill does not call audit-mcp; the caller runs `/audit focus=<dim>` per dimension at the depth `docs/policies/audit-trigger.md` selects. Does not replace the host built-in /review slash command.

sentence_patterns: 这次改了 5 个文件, 想从 logic / edge / security / perf / concurrency 5 维度审
/ultrareview 跨 LLM 版本, 给我 5 维 audit 路由 prompt
多文件改动想拿 cross-LLM panel 各维度独立判断
审一下 logic / performance / concurrency 3 维就行, 不要全 5 维
Run aqg-multi-review new to emit 5-dim ledger skeleton

cli_contract.0: success — `new` printed skeleton OR `validate` ledger valid
cli_contract.1: validation failure — `validate` found schema/missing-dim violations in ledger
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args / unknown subcommand

owner_only_actions: Production / branch protection / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates; multi-review only emits per-dim focus prompts + ledger skeleton, never calls audit-mcp itself (per ADR 2026-05-09-multi-dimension-review-skill-a1.md §5)

cases.prompt: This change touched 5 files — I want to review across logic / edge / security / perf / concurrency (5 dimensions)
/ultrareview cross-LLM version — give me the 5-dimension audit routing prompts
Multi-file change — I want a cross-LLM panel with an independent judgment per dimension
Just review the logic / performance / concurrency 3 dimensions — not all 5
Please use the /aqg-multi-review skill to produce the 5-dimension ledger skeleton + focus prompts
